name: tether_v004
hypothesis: An inflated A* planner plus a domain-randomized residual controller can execute destination commands through reachable clutter layouts while preserving tether clearance.
algorithm: SB3 PPO residual motor control with geometric route planner
notes: Six randomized physical boxes, including a straight-path blocker. Reachable layouts only; bounded 2D A* provides waypoints, PD plus PPO follows. Ground-truth geometry/state, not vision. No guarantee for arbitrary obstacles. Test seeds reserved for final main-run evaluation.
